mode: The RTX 4090 native component changed, so its documented route was run end to end from the published package: 7/7 blocks, downloading and installing v0.6.4-qwen38-4090-beta.1 from its public URLs against the manifest's hashes. Both RTX 5090 routes were re-run as well because their own text now names the v0.7.1 release directory, though that lane's component, image and deployment profile are unchanged. The Windows client route carries explicitly attributed evidence: its blocks are byte-identical and the client is unchanged.
